mentions.name: Leafle
mentions.description: A personalized book recommendation service that also suggests library books to borrow. It uses LLMs as the user-facing interface and as a research/reverse-engineering tool, and applies automated quality filtering (e.g., banning low-quality OpenRouter providers based on their output) before recommendations reach users. The builder promotes it with flyers at local libraries.
mentions.problem: Finding worthwhile books (including library books) that a reader wouldn't have thought of reading on their own.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working away on my book (and library book) recommendations service https://leafle.org
